question: Does Ditto beat MuseTalk on a CLEAN body (mouth closed, calm head), same audio?
why_not: No RUNPOD_API_KEY, no FAL_KEY, no MAYA_ASSETS_TOKEN, no SSH key in this container. No pod could be created and no fal Kling body could be generated, so no Ditto frames exist to measure. Nothing was simulated or estimated.

measured_this_session.method: maya-lt bench/results/nova-ab/tools/lipcorr.py, mediapipe 0.10.32 face_landmarker, inner-lip gap (13-14)/face height vs audio RMS per 40 ms frame, Pearson at lag 0 and best over -25..+25 frames
measured_this_session.video_prep: crop=626:1112:246:276,scale=1080:1920:flags=lanczos, -r 25 -> 1575 frames / 63.0 s (identical to the prior run)

reproduces_prior_run.note: delta is the crf 18 vs crf 16 re-encode; face_found_pct 99.2 identical both runs

ditto_clean_body.caveat: That 'clean body' is the idle_sway ping-pong loop, which itself gates REJECT with mouth_p95 0.059 - her resting mouth sits open. No Nova body has ever passed the gate. A genuinely closed-mouth body has never been measured with Ditto.
